name: Azabu Masumi
source:
The protagonist's classmate.

She has a cheerful personality and is easy to get along with, so she's easily become the center of attention. She teased the protagonist who is kind of estranged from the rest of the class like she's making fun of him, but is that her true intention...?

[Edited from [url=http://www.hook-net.jp/htm/goods/azasumi.htm]Official Website[/url]]
